workflow: STEP 1: Clone the baseline layout, starry particle background, typography, and section structure of the source website (https://cutsbyshivam.framer.website/) into a standalone, pure HTML5/CSS3/JS codebase (Vite-compatible). Ensure all Framer React hydration scripts and Framer watermarks/badges are completely removed so the site renders cleanly as static HTML without blank-screen hydration errors.
STEP 2: Apply 100% of the custom overrides, theme transformations, interactive widgets, and branding replacements specified in this JSON.
STEP 3: Replace the source's purple/violet theme with the Deep Royal Blue (#2563eb, #3b82f6, #60a5fa) + Rich Dark Black (#000000) theme.

STEP 4: Integrate the custom 3-video visible Short-Form carousel, the 3-card Problem section with live pulses, the 100% in-page 3-step Booking Calendar (zero external redirects), and the floating Gemini AI Chatbot in the bottom-right corner.

items.question: What is your turnaround time for video edits?
items.answer: For Short-Form videos (Reels, Shorts, TikToks), turnaround is typically 24-48 hours. For Long-Form YouTube videos (10-25 mins), turnaround is 3-4 business days including sound design, color grading, and motion graphics.

items.question: How do we transfer footage and assets?
items.answer: We use Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io, or MASV for lightning-fast, lossless file transfers. You simply upload your raw footage and we handle the rest.

items.question: How do revisions work?
items.answer: Every project includes 2 rounds of free revisions using timestamped review tools like Frame.io, ensuring the final video matches your exact vision.

items.question: What software and toolchain do you edit in?
items.answer: We edit professionally using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve Studio (for cinematic color grading), and Photoshop/Illustrator for custom thumbnails and graphic assets.

items.question: Do you offer monthly retainer packages?
items.answer: Yes! Most creators and brands work with us on monthly retainers for dedicated bandwidth and discounted rates.
